title: House recolor silently skips a missing/renamed tone material slot; stale coral passes the W5 guard and is blessed
detail: A renamed/deleted house_fill_* slot makes .get() return None; the skip renders the stale coral face into house_1..3. The bbox guard only rejects empty/edge-clipped renders, so this misfire is written to assets/sprites silently.
recommended_fix: When colorway is set, require the family's expected slots (house: fill/roofshade/lit/mid/shade) to exist; raise SystemExit on a missing one instead of skipping.

title: Puck solo walks only direct scene-collection children and direct members; root-level or nested objects escape it and render into every tier
detail: Objects linked directly to sc.collection, or inside nested sub-collections, are never touched: a stray root/nested mesh renders into all three puck sprites. If the union stays interior, the bbox guard passes and wrong-tier content is blessed.
recommended_fix: Iterate all collections recursively (sc.collection.children_all / traverse) plus sc.collection.objects, or assert the scene root has no renderable objects and tiers are direct children before soloing.

title: Solo unconditionally unhides every object in the target tier, overriding sculptor hide_render=True state
detail: For the soloed collection this assigns hide_render=False to all objects, force-showing WIP/deprecated geometry the sculptor deliberately hid inside a tier; prior hide state is never read or preserved.
recommended_fix: Track originally-hidden objects once per family (or use a per-tier exclusion collection) and preserve hide_render=True instead of blanket-unhiding the solo tier.

title: W4 elevation labels pin 'pucks ≈65° steepest (pad 0.95)' but the same diff sets the puck pad to 1.15 (≈60.8°) — the 65° endpoint is unreachable
evidence:
"puck_1":   ("puck",  1.15, "tier_4",  None),
    "puck_2":   ("puck",  1.15, "tier_8",  None),
    "puck_3":   ("puck",  1.15, "tier_16", None),
--- docstring ---
    atan(9.9 / (0.35 + 4.5*pad)) — pad 0.95 (pucks) => ~65deg STEEP (nearest
    top-down); pad 1.95 (campus) => ~47deg SHALLOW (most oblique).
detail: With pad 1.15 the puck elevation is atan(9.9/5.525)≈60.8°; committed range is 47.3° (campus) to 61.4° (house, now steepest). README.md:46 and docs/silhouette-spec.md:40 repeat the stale ~65° pucks-steepest claim.
recommended_fix: Recompute labels from the committed SPRITE_SPECS pads (~47-61°, house steepest, pucks ≈61°) in gen_sprites.py docstring, README, and silhouette-spec §0.
